name: Nature Sound Walk
mission_steps: Find a quiet spot in a park or nature reserve.
Close your eyes and listen to the sounds around you.
Try to identify the different sounds you hear.
safety_notes: Be mindful of your surroundings and avoid disturbing wildlife.
memory_prompts: What was the most interesting sound you heard?

name: Street Art Scavenger Hunt
mission_steps: Find a street art mural in your neighborhood.
Take a photo of the mural and note its location.
Research the artist and learn more about their work.
safety_notes: Be respectful of private property and avoid disturbing the artist.
memory_prompts: What was the most striking feature of the mural?

name: Wildflower Identification
mission_steps: Find a field or meadow with wildflowers.
Identify the different types of flowers and note their characteristics.
Research the flowers and learn more about their habitats and uses.
safety_notes: Be mindful of your surroundings and avoid disturbing the flowers.
memory_prompts: What was the most interesting thing you learned about the wildflowers?

name: Bird Watching
mission_steps: Find a bird-watching spot in a park or nature reserve.
Bring binoculars and a field guide to help identify the birds.
Note the different species you see and their behaviors.
safety_notes: Be mindful of your surroundings and avoid disturbing the birds.
memory_prompts: What was the most interesting thing you learned about the birds?

safety_notes: Be respectful of private property and avoid disturbing the landmark.
